description:
## Problem
BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site#242 (branch `docs/run-timeout-error-import`, base `next`) updates the site for BenchBox-dev/benchbox#4446: `from benchbox.core.exceptions import RunTimeoutError` in `docs/usage/data-generation.md` and in the run-time-limit row of `docs/reference/public-contracts.md`; `ExecutionConfigHelper.optimize_for_system(cpu_cores)` without `memory_gb` and without memory-based timeouts in `docs/reference/python-api/utilities.md`, `docs/usage/configuration.md`, `docs/usage/examples.md` and `docs/advanced/power-run-concurrent-queries.md`; and `timeout_minutes=120` dropped from the built-in execution defaults. It cannot merge: its required job `lint, types, unit tests and build` (run 45049199136) fails at "Check the site documentation against the docs inputs' contracts" with the same three TPC-DI violations that fail `next` itself (CI 44985668836 on 7e90968, red since 2026-11-22 04:34Z). Making `next` green is tpcdi-site-next-contract-red-20261122. The repository does not allow auto-merge, so someone must merge once `next` is green. This site-only merge is tracked here because it completes core #4446.

## Change
Once `next` passes CI, update #242 with `next` (merge, no force-push), re-run its checks, and squash-merge it. Make no other content change unless the merged BenchBox code changed again; if it did, re-check each sentence against `benchbox/core/exceptions.py`, `benchbox/utils/run_deadline.py` and `benchbox/utils/config_helpers.py` on develop.

## Decision gates
- Do not fix the TPC-DI contract violations in this pull request; they belong to tpcdi-site-next-contract-red-20261122.
- If `next` or #242 stays red for any other reason, stop and record it on this item; never merge around a failed required check.

## Verification rubric
Pass: #242 merged into `next` with its CI green on the merged head; in a worktree of `next` after the merge, `npm run lint:docs`, `npm run test:docs-contracts` and `npm run docs:check` (with `DOCS_INPUTS=.site-inputs` after `npm run bundle:fetch`, as CI runs it) pass; `git grep -nE 'run_deadline import RunTimeoutError|optimize_for_system\([^)]*memory_gb' -- docs` on `next` prints nothing (other `memory_gb` names such as `environment.memory_gb`, `total_memory_gb` and `max_memory_gb` are different settings and stay).
Fail: any of these not met.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree of BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site (`git -C /Users/joe/Developer/benchbox-site worktree add ../benchbox-site.wt-<slug> <branch>`); never edit `/Users/joe/Developer/benchbox-site` itself. benchbox-site has no Makefile; its checks are `npm run` scripts. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
